title: Bug 650429: [Repair Item] [Subcontracting] Show Document opens the wrong transfer order from Transfer Lines (Page 5749)
summary: In the Italian version, Show Document on the Transfer Lines page (5749) no longer opens the wrong transfer order for legacy subcontracting. The page now calculates the subcontracting-order FlowField before choosing which transfer order page to open.
key_points: Fixes Show Document on Transfer Lines opening the wrong transfer order in Italian legacy subcontracting
Calculates the subcontracting-order FlowField before selecting the transfer order page
Adds an Italian legacy-subcontracting navigation regression test
quote: calculate the subcontracting-order FlowField before selecting the transfer-order page
